# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly 30 to 35 years old  <sub>[v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ontario  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist and writer  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian has a tall, broad-shouldered frame complemented by dense brown hair, a sharp nose and chin, and expansive, luminous dark-gray eyes. He is considered quite good-looking, possessing a pleasant voice, a charming smile, and a good sense of style. At times, he displays a distinct pallor and visible signs of sleeplessness.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006), [v4 c26 P1](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Adrian is pleasant, well-mannered, and articulate, though he can occasionally lean toward grandiloquent speech. He is an engaging companion who easily wins the affection of those around him through genuine appreciation and charm. Passionate about his creative pursuits, he can become deeply preoccupied when wrestling with intense emotions or working demanding hours on his writing.

_Sources: [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007), [v4 c26 P1](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0001), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)_

## Traits

- Charming and pleasant  <sub>[v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- Given to grandiloquent speech  <sub>[v4 c26 P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)</sub>
- Confiding and honest  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- Short story and newspaper writing  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
- Book authorship  <sub>[v4 c28 P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035), [v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005)</sub>
- Photography  <sub>[v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To find the time and theme to write a book  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
- To visit the ancient homestead where his grandparents resided  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- To win the love and hand of Lorna Vane  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c34 P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001)</sub>

## History

Following a severe bout of typhoid, Adrian was advised by his doctor to seek recovery near the ocean. He traveled to the coastal area of Seven Gulls to view the old homestead of his grandparents, the Tremaynes. During his summer stay, he spent mornings writing and afternoons engaging in outdoor excursions, fishing, and boating with the Carrow family, Lorna Vane, and Captain Saul. During this time, he collaborated with James Garrick to write *The Life-Book of Captain Saul*, taking a photograph of Captain Saul that was later included in the volume. He fell deeply in love with Lorna Vane, though he wrestled in private over his feelings. After returning from his summer stay, he received word that his manuscript was accepted for publication. Later, while residing in Vancouver, he wrote to arrange another month's room and board, returning to court Lorna.

_Sources: [v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c25 P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c28 P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035), [v4 c34 P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Son of an Ontario resident named Treleaven and Alice Tremayne  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022)</sub>
- Grandson of schoolmaster John Tremayne  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- Suffered a severe attack of typhoid during the spring  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- Composed short stories for various magazines while working as a journalist  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

## Quotes

> I have composed quite a few short stories for various magazines, yet I have lacked the free time that appears required to produce a book. However, given a three-month period of freedom, I should begin—if I were merely able to obtain the required theme for it—the SOUL of the work.  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

> Grandson; indeed, my mother was Alice Tremayne.  <sub>[v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022)</sub>

> Having the doctor absent makes me somewhat pleased. Mrs. Carrow, my intention was to meet with you privately. If I do not disclose something to someone, it feels as though it will push me to insanity. For seven days, I have attempted to confront it directly—yet I am unable to do so. You possess my trust, I am certain—plus, comprehension will come to you. Understanding is constant in a woman whose eyes resemble yours. You belong to those individuals who naturally draw confidences from others. Lorna is loved by me, Mrs. Carrow. LOVED! A word that faint hardly seems sufficient!  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)</sub>
